primary_endpoint: false_clear_rate among cases where reassurance must not be released
mode_a: Frozen raw DAV product identity input through SBMI normalization/reconciliation to the DDI engine.
mode_b: Frozen accepted external oracle identity supplied to the same DDI engine; decomposition only, not a substitute benchmark.
mode_reproducibility_constraint: Mode A and Mode B share sealed source manifests, case IDs, eligible pairs, DDI engine/configuration, mappings, exclusions, statistics plan, and release rules; only the identity input boundary may differ.
unknown_label_rule: not-in-reference is unknown and excluded from negative/specificity denominators
paired_analysis: Exact McNemar where valid; prespecified contrast families use Holm correction.
freeze_requirement: Sources, mappings, development-only tuning, split, baselines, metrics and this plan must be frozen and hash-bound before locked testing.
